show_title: Invest Like the Best with Patrick O'Shaughnessy
title: Dinakar Singh - A Father’s Call To Action - [Invest Like the Best, EP.428]
summary: Dinakar is the founder and CEO of Axon, the family office successor to TPG-Axon, which was a successful global long-short hedge fund. I was thinking about how to ask about it to kick us off and maybe the appropriate way is just to ask you: why did you name your firm TPG-Axon?
